# NG Hip Hop Platform

> Built From Bars. Raised By Beats. The official platform for NG Hip Hop — authentic music, community quotes, graffiti art, and lyric challenges from Eswatini.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://ng-hiphop.com): Hero, latest release, featured quote, graffiti showcase, lyric game, competition banner
- [Music Library](https://ng-hiphop.com/library): Full discography of active releases
- [Terms of Service](https://ng-hiphop.com/terms): Platform terms and conditions
- [Privacy Policy](https://ng-hiphop.com/privacy): Data handling and consent policy

## Content by Topic

### Music
- [Music Library](/library): Stream all active releases, from classics to latest drops — 100 songs max per page

### Community
- Featured quotes appear on the homepage via `/api/quotes` (server-side fetched)
- Graffiti showcase on the homepage via `/api/graffiti`
- Lyric game challenge on the homepage via `/api/lyrics`

### Legal
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Acceptance, IP, user content, disclaimer
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): Data collection, consent, retention
